sections.heading: Fuseoperator
sections.content: The Fuse operator uses approximated k-means clustering to fuse neighbor particles within a certain radius together (by deleting all particles except for the particle at the center of each fusion sphere).

sections.heading: Operation
sections.content:
Fuse if position in radius: a particle will be fused with another particle if its position is inside the first particle’s fuse radius.Fuse if radii overlap: a particle will be fused with another particle if its fuse radius overlaps the first particle’s fuse radius.Fuse if convex hulls overlap: a particle will be fused with another particle if the convex hulls of the two particles overlap.

Fuse if position in radius: a particle will be fused with another particle if its position is inside the first particle’s fuse radius.

Fuse if radii overlap: a particle will be fused with another particle if its fuse radius overlaps the first particle’s fuse radius.

Fuse if convex hulls overlap: a particle will be fused with another particle if the convex hulls of the two particles overlap.

Convex hull overlap mode requires particles to have shape meshes assigned to them.

sections.heading: Radius
sections.content:
Radius type: the particle property from which to derive the base radius value.Radius: the absolute radius value.Multiplier: the multiplier to apply to shape/scale radius values.

Radius type: the particle property from which to derive the base radius value.

Radius: the absolute radius value.

Multiplier: the multiplier to apply to shape/scale radius values.

Sort fusions by radii: when enabled, particles will be fused with respect to their radii - for any two given particles, the larger particle will remain after a fusion occurs.

sections.heading: Dynamic fusion
sections.content:
Fuse affects volume: when enabled, the remaining particle will have its volume increased by the volume of the fused particle.Fuse affects position: when enabled, the remaining particle will be moved proportionally towards the fused particle.Fuse affects velocity: when enabled, the remaining particle will have its velocity shifted towards the fused particle.

Fuse affects volume: when enabled, the remaining particle will have its volume increased by the volume of the fused particle.

Fuse affects position: when enabled, the remaining particle will be moved proportionally towards the fused particle.

Fuse affects velocity: when enabled, the remaining particle will have its velocity shifted towards the fused particle.

sections.heading: Clusters
sections.content:
Enable clustering: when enabled, only particles of the same/different cluster will be fused, depending on selected cluster mode.Cluster channel: the custom data float channel from which to retrieve the cluster info.Mode: the clustering mode.

Enable clustering: when enabled, only particles of the same/different cluster will be fused, depending on selected cluster mode.

Cluster channel: the custom data float channel from which to retrieve the cluster info.

Mode: the clustering mode.

sections.heading: Convex Hulls
sections.content: Scale: a scale multiplier applied to the hulls used in the convex hull overlap test.

sections.heading: Local Offsets
sections.content: X/Y/Z: position offsets in each particle’s local transform space used to control the position of each particle’s fusion sphere location.

sections.heading: Display
sections.content: Display fuse spheres: displays the fuse spheres in the viewport.

sections.heading: Uniqueness
sections.content: Seed: the seed value for all varied parameters.
